target: Borrador de fauna natural de la Sierra de Hoshai para poblar terrazas y matorral de altura; no integrar a runtime.
art_direction: Fauna menor territorial de montaña. Mostrar un pequeño herbívoro adulto construido para saltos entre terrazas: cuerpo compacto y ligero, cuatro extremidades, patas traseras claramente más largas y potentes que las delanteras, pezuñas divididas visibles y postura alerta sobre roca inclinada. Debe sentirse adaptado a desnivel y altura, no como una cabra doméstica ni un ciervo en miniatura. Ambiente de Hoshai frío, rocoso y ventoso, subordinado al animal.
prompt: Create one landscape wildlife scene in the Sierra de Hoshai. Show one complete adult Saltacresta, a small natural mountain herbivore standing on a narrow rocky terrace just before a jump. Exactly four limbs. CRITICAL SILHOUETTE: compact lightweight torso; short sturdy forelegs; dramatically longer, muscular folded hind legs built for explosive vertical and lateral jumps; clearly split cloven hooves gripping uneven stone. Keep the head compact and alert, suited to browsing low mountain shoots, without oversized horns or fantasy ornament. The animal looks toward a neighboring terrace while keeping its weight loaded over the hind legs. Natural fur in muted cold mountain tones: stone gray, dusty brown, subdued cream. Sparse high-altitude scrub, layered rock, distant drop and strong wind cues. Natural territorial fauna, not a monster and not attacking.
negative_constraints: Exactly four limbs; no extra legs, wings or membranes
Do not depict a domestic goat, sheep, deer, antelope or rabbit; silhouette must be its own mountain fauna
No oversized horns, antlers, tusks, spikes or armor
Hind legs must be visibly longer and more powerful than forelegs
Cloven split hooves must be readable
No heroic predator pose, attack pose, magic, glow or Arcane traits
No dominant golden/ochre lighting; use cool natural mountain daylight
notes: Dirección de Arte basada únicamente en canon existente. Mantenerlo como fauna natural menor territorial; no añadir combate ni rasgos Arcane.
